The existing GF -> TSMC interposer edge sits under GF's silicon-photonics PIC placement in optical_networking.json, whose product does not match; this placement puts the interposer role in the CoWoS chain.

Definitely, we have a little bit shortage on the back end, and we would like to work with our so-called partner with GlobalFoundries so that both TSMC and GlobalFoundries can support TSMC's customer for their product to be introduced with enough support on the capacity.'
